payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes largest k for which bitwise AND from n down to k is 0 by finding 2^{bit_length(n)-1} - 1, creating a mask with all lower bits set.
payload.rationale: The solution directly uses bit manipulation: extract bit-length via bin conversion, then compute 2^{len-1} - 1. This is a classic bitmask creation trick (setting all lower bits to 1), aligning with bit_set_operations.
